display.title: Mowzie's Mobs: Frostmaw
display.subtitle: Wake and slay the ice beast
description: In the frozen reaches of §bEverbright§r (Blue Skies) sleeps §bFrostmaw§r, a
great frost beast guarding a frozen lair. Strike the icicle it clutches to
rouse it, then weather its roars and swipes until it falls.
§7A frigid Tier 2 hunt. Bring fire resistance into the cold.
